generator.command: env MPLCONFIGDIR=/tmp/mdpi-air-matplotlib conda run --no-capture-output -n brc-tools python verification/scripts/plot_episode_context.py --ozone-csv verification/data/aqs_ozone_daily_janfeb2013_selected.csv --modis-png verification/figures/candidates/modis_uinta_snow_false_color_20130202_near1800.png --output verification/figures/candidates/episode_context_snow_ozone_janfeb2013

ozone_input.daily_value: EPA-reported 1st Max Value for Ozone 8-hour 2015, converted from ppm to ppb
ozone_input.coverage_display: markers are hollow when AQS Observation Percent is below 75

satellite_input.role: cropped registered NASA GIBS daily browse render; qualitative snow/cloud context only

checks: five site series, units, case-date marker, and low-coverage markers are legible
satellite crop retains the three location labels and qualitative snow/cloud field
no regulatory threshold, chemistry result, or WRF-validation claim appears

interpretation_limits: The NASA GIBS image is a calendar-day browse layer, not a raw selected-granule crop or quantitative snow retrieval.
The AQS values are reported local-date daily summaries; within-day observation coverage varies.
The figure establishes episode context only and does not evaluate chemistry, attainment, emissions, or meteorological causation.
